title: Model operator-approved pairing claims
description:
SPIDR prerequisite for P1.1. Replace the committed one-time bearer window from commit 678054f with a bounded in-memory pairing-approval state machine. The browser may request a claim and receive a non-authoritative confirmation label; only a separately authenticated operator call may approve that label; only the matching request may claim once.

DELIVERABLE: a focused pairing approval module with CSPRNG request identities, bounded pending requests, monotonic 60-second expiry, explicit PENDING/APPROVED/CLAIMED transitions, and immutable typed results. It mints no session and owns no HTTP route.

NOT IN SCOPE: HTTP authentication/routes, daemon/launcher output, browser UI, session minting, or any credential in a URL/argv/log.

ORDERING: this must land before the listener integration row. Reusing the old presented-token comparison after this point would preserve the exact bearer race P1.1 exists to remove.

VERIFICATION COMMAND: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/http/pairing-approval-window.test.ts`; it must exit 0 with nonzero Test Files and Tests counts.
definitionOfDone: Verify-or-block at the delivered tree: commit 678054f is an ancestor, pairing-token-window has exactly one production consumer in http-listener.ts, and no live task owns the five rename/replacement paths; otherwise report BLOCKED before edits.

The old pairing-token-window.ts/.js surface is retired and replaced by pairing-approval-window.ts/.js plus focused tests; no stale exported token-comparison or reserve-by-presented-bearer API remains.

The production state machine creates bounded CSPRNG request identities and non-authoritative confirmation labels, permits approval only as a distinct method call, and permits only the matching approved request to claim exactly once.

Pending requests expire at the exclusive 60-second monotonic deadline and never revive after clock rollback; malformed, unknown, expired, claimed, and capacity-exhausted inputs fail closed with exact immutable code and layer.

A racing request that has not received operator approval returns exactly `PAIRING_APPROVAL_REQUIRED` at `CONTROL_ROOM_PAIRING_APPROVAL`; approving one request never approves any other pending request.

Focused tests assert nonzero generated hostile cases and exact code/layer, and production mutation drills for cross-request approval and expiry rollback make the named assertions red before exact-path restore proof.
taskRails: The confirmation label is not authority: no public method may turn possession of the label alone into a claim; production approval is composed only by the later authenticated listener row.
No bearer, session credential, operator credential, or substitute credential may be logged, printed, stored durably, embedded in a URL, or placed in argv.
Use CSPRNG material in production, injected deterministically only in tests; bound every collection and input length.
TDD, per-production-file size caps, and explicit-pathspec commits apply.
